# Craft Courses

> > Craft Courses connects thousands of UK craft makers and artists with learners, offering hands-on workshops, DIY kits, and artisan gifts across diverse disciplines.

Craft Courses is a marketplace platform that aggregates craft workshops, courses, and handmade gifts from makers across the UK, with a focus on beginner-friendly, in-person learning experiences. The platform also enables craftspeople to teach and earn through their instructor onboarding program.

## Key Topics

- craft courses
- UK makers
- hands-on workshops
- beginner-friendly
- in-person learning
- metalworking
- blacksmithing
- pottery
- woodcarving

- glass fusing
- bookbinding
- gift vouchers
- special occasions
- artisan gifts

## Core Platform

- [Craft Courses: Art & craft workshops with 1000s of UK makers](https://www.craftcourses.com): Homepage connecting users with 1000s of UK craft makers and workshops
- [All courses, craft kits and handcrafted gifts](https://www.craftcourses.com/craft-workshops): Main directory of all craft courses, DIY kits, and artisan gifts
- [About us: Connecting you with Craftspeople & Artists across the UK](https://www.craftcourses.com/about_pages/show): Company mission connecting craftspeople and artists across UK

## Gifts & Special Occasions

- [Gift vouchers](https://www.craftcourses.com/gift-vouchers): Gift vouchers for craft courses and experience gifts
- [Special Occasions](https://www.craftcourses.com/special-occasions): Craft courses and gifts for weddings, birthdays, celebrations

## Featured Workshops & Courses

- [Parent and child blacksmithing](https://www.craftcourses.com/courses/parent-and-child-blacksmithing): Parent-child blacksmithing workshop in Reading, Berkshire
- [2 Day Axe Making Course](https://www.craftcourses.com/courses/2-day-axe-making-course-1): Two-day beginner axe making and blacksmithing course in Hereford
- [Learn the Potters' Wheel in a Weekend](https://www.craftcourses.com/courses/learn-to-use-the-potters-wheel): Weekend pottery wheel course on Dartmoor, Devon
- [Introduction to Spoon Carving at Steeky Meadow](https://www.craftcourses.com/courses/spoon-carving-at-steeky-meadow): Beginner spoon carving course in Devon at Steeky Meadow
- [Beginner's figurative carving](https://www.craftcourses.com/courses/beginner-s-figurative-carving): Beginner wood carving course in Norfolk featuring figurative techniques
- [Needle felted Green Woodpecker (inc delicious lunch)](https://www.craftcourses.com/courses/needle-felted-green-woodpecker): Full-day needle felting workshop in East Sussex with lunch
- [Beginners/improvers glass fusing workshops in Hemingford Grey, Cambridgeshire](https://www.craftcourses.com/courses/beginnersimprovers-glass-fusing-workshop-in-hemingford-grey-cambridgeshire): Glass fusing workshop for beginners in Cambridgeshire
- [Silk Screen Printing Workshop in Burford, Oxfordshire – Beginner Stencil Printing on Fabric](https://www.craftcourses.com/courses/silk-screen-printing-workshop): Beginner silk screen printing and fabric stencil workshop in Oxfordshire
- [Bookbinding & Journal Making Workshop - Junk Journalling - Bookbinding - Farmland Museum](https://www.craftcourses.com/courses/bookbinding-journal-making-workshop-junk-journalling-bookbinding-farmland-museum): Bookbinding and junk journalling workshop at Farmland Museum Cambridge
